title: Northrop Grumman / Area 51 ARV story called a myth

tellings.quote: I said so what's the story about North or gemman had having an arv or somebody out at Area 51 having an arv and he said oh that's all myth

related.note: The same subject as Lazar's claim of an ARV being reverse-engineered at Area 51, but this source calls the ARV story a myth, so the core claim conflicts with Lazar's.

plain: Eric Davis, a physicist who has worked on Pentagon-linked UFO research, says he asked an insider about stories that the aerospace company Northrop Grumman, or someone at Area 51, a secret US air base in Nevada, had an ARV, meaning a human-built copy of a non-human craft. According to Davis, the man answered that it was all myth. This bears on claims like those of Bob Lazar, a man who has said he worked on alien craft near Area 51.
